scope: every sense authored in tick 7 (shard 16), drawn complete rather than sampled
authoring: parallel author agents on Opus 5, family-author.md read verbatim from disk, prompts identical across all 20 families
comparability: fully comparable to censuses 007, 008 and 009 on both instruments
pre_read_checks: tone_lint clean on all rules including family-inconsistent (3 notes rephrased for etymology/hedge false positives before the read); family_apply axis-direction check clean after one reversal

entries.definition: not having or showing or requiring special skill or proficiency
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Classifying rather than condemning - it covers work that asks for no special skill just as evenly as a hand that has none, where *botchy* is already a verdict on the result.
examples: unskilled in the art of rhetoric
workers in unskilled occupations are finding fewer and fewer job opportunities

entries.definition: showing lack of art
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names an absence rather than a mess - what is made shows no art in it, which is a thinner charge than the spoilage *botched* points at.

entries.definition: poorly done
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dismissive and slightly contemptuous - the badness is lumpy and visible, something you can see in the thing itself.

entries.definition: poorly done
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most violent way to call work bad - it makes the poor doing sound like hacking, where *botchy* only makes it look untidy.

entries.definition: poorly done
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat, unloaded member of its set - it states that the doing fell short of skill and stops, supplying none of the disgust in *butcherly*.

entries.definition: spoiled through incompetence or clumsiness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Settles the failure as done and irreversible - the thing was spoiled in the handling and now stands spoiled.

entries.definition: spoiled through incompetence or clumsiness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coarser than *bungled* - the spoiling is crude and shows, a wreck left behind rather than a slip.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the ineptitude into a standing quality - not one attempt gone wrong but the manner of the doer.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest of its set and the most forgivable - it faults the handling while *incompetent* faults the capacity.

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Catches the lack of skill in motion - hands groping and losing hold, rather than the finished judgement *incompetent* delivers.
examples: his fumbling attempt to put up a shelf

entries.definition: showing lack of skill or aptitude
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal verdict of the family - it withholds the aptitude altogether, where *clumsy* grants it and blames only the execution.

entries.definition: not carefully or expertly made
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the making as unrefined and hastily finished, an aesthetic complaint rather than the flat incapacity of *incompetent*.
examples: managed to make a crude splint
a crude cabin of logs with bark still on them

entries.definition: not carefully or expertly made
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest complaint available about workmanship - it concedes the care was not taken while leaving *crude* to sound the note of coarseness.

entries.definition: of a person unable to do something skillfully
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Aimed at the person and not the product, it writes off the ability rather than the attempt, with an exasperation that can shade into fondness.

entries.definition: not noticed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records only that notice did not happen, imputing no fault to anyone and no claim on attention to the thing itself.
examples: hoped his departure had passed unnoticed

entries.definition: not noticed inadvertently
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: In this sense the passing-over is accidental, so the word marks a lapse rather than a snub.

entries.definition: not noticed inadvertently
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same inadvertent lapse as *disregarded*, but it implies the thing once held attention and lost it, which leaves a faint diminishment on it.
examples: her aching muscles forgotten she danced all night
he was scolded for his forgotten chores

entries.definition: disregarded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one where withholding attention reads as chosen - a snub rather than an oversight, and the sting sits in that choice.

entries.definition: disregarded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the weight on attention that was owed and not paid, so it carries a sense of duty unmet that *ignored* does not.
examples: Shaw's neglected one-act comedy, ‘A Village Wooing’

entries.definition: disregarded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest of the three: it grants that something stood there to be attended to, without *ignored*'s deliberateness or *neglected*'s failure of care.

entries.definition: not taken into account
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A miss rather than a refusal - it concedes that the thing should have entered the reckoning and quietly admits the error.

entries.definition: not taken into account
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat where *overlooked* is apologetic: it says only that nothing was made of the thing, conceding no mistake.
examples: his retirement was not allowed to go unmarked

entries.definition: not taken into account
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The barest of the three - the plain negative of taking something into account, with no suggestion that anyone should have.

entries.definition: unnoticed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries the shadow of someone who might have noticed, so it can be a relief as easily as a slight.

entries.definition: unnoticed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly sensory beside *unobserved* - nothing registered, with no watcher implied for the thing to have escaped.

entries.definition: not perceived or commented on
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and abstract, covering both the failure to register a thing and the silence that follows, with its weight on the registering.

entries.definition: not perceived or commented on
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Holds the same pair tipped the other way - the thing may well have been seen, and the point is that nothing was said of it.

entries.definition: not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat statement of the fault - nothing fresh in the thing and nothing fresh coming out of it - delivered without the scorn *trite* carries.
examples: his life had been unoriginal, conforming completely to the given pattern

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dismissal rather than description: the repetition has emptied the thing out, where *commonplace* only notes that it has been met before.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest reproach in the set - it registers the overfamiliarity and stops there, leaving the contempt to *banal*.
examples: his remarks were trite and commonplace

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A formal-sounding verdict that the thing has been run into the ground, heavier and more deliberate than *tired*.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and offhand: it shrugs at how familiar the thing has become instead of condemning it the way *banal* does.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The overuse leaves a mark, as though the thing had been handled until the shine came off it - grubbier than *well-worn*.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest word here - it files the endless repetition almost as a category rather than a fault, with none of the disgust in *trite*.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The wear has gone all the way through: the thing still holds its shape but has nothing left in it, harsher than *well-worn*.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Softer than the rest, because it lays the wearing at time's door rather than anyone's, so the reproach lands gently.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and plain: the thing has simply gone slack from repetition, a flatter judgement than the arch *bromidic*.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The hardest word in the family - it does not merely note the overuse, it writes the thing off as worthless for it.
examples: his remarks were trite and commonplace

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest of the group: the wear is admitted and half forgiven, where *threadbare* would call it ruin.

entries.definition: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Keeps a straight face while it convicts - dull, wearying and puffed up with significance, all named at once, where *corny* simply laughs.

entries.definition: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and mocking: both the dullness and the airs come off as laughable, lighter on its feet than *platitudinous*.

entries.definition: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The drier of the pair - it names the tiresome self-importance almost clinically, without the heavy roll of *platitudinous*.

entries.definition: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A weightier, more sonorous word than *platitudinal*, and its own bulk is part of the mockery: dullness dressed up and then shown up.

entries.definition: causing physical or psychological pain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain term of the family - it reports that something hurts, in the body or in the mind, without saying how sharply or how much.

entries.definition: causing a dull and steady pain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Low and unbroken - a pain with no edge on it, the opposite of the sting in *biting*.

entries.definition: causing a dull and steady pain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal where *aching* is plain, and the shortened shape keeps the same dull, steady pain small.

entries.definition: expressing pain or agony
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turned outward - it describes the look or the cry that shows pain, agony included, not the thing doing the hurting.

entries.definition: expressing pain or agony
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling of *agonized* and identical in force - distress made visible rather than inflicted.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Far past *aching* - the pain is extreme, and the word lends it agony's whole weight.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling of *agonizing*, with the same extremity and no softening.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The absolute of the set - it admits no degree above itself, so anything short of unbearable is overstated by it.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Extremity felt as an ordeal - where *excruciating* measures the pain, this measures what it costs whoever goes through it.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Extremity cast as an act - the pain is not merely present but done to someone, which *excruciating* never says.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The quality without the agent - pain of the order torture produces, said of the experience rather than of anyone inflicting it.

entries.definition: extremely painful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heavier build beside *torturous* - identical extremity, carried in a more laboured word.

entries.definition: causing a sharply painful or stinging sensation; used especially of cold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sharp and stinging where *aching* is dull, and cold above all is what it is said of.

entries.definition: causing a sharply painful or stinging sensation; used especially of cold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same sharp sting held as a condition rather than an act - a bitter cold surrounds you where a biting one goes at you.

entries.definition: painful from having the skin abraded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Small and local - the soreness of skin rubbed raw, at the shallow end of everything else here.

entries.definition: painful from having the skin abraded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunter than *chafed* for the same abraded skin, with the sore itself in view rather than the rubbing that made it.

entries.definition: capable of happening or existing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare floor of the family - it says only that the thing is not ruled out, and promises nothing about anyone being able to bring it off.
examples: a breakthrough may be possible next year

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and effortful, it frames the thing as a task with a finish line where *possible* frames nothing at all.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *accomplishable* - it treats the thing as a goal worth reaching and quietly credits whoever would reach it.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest and most informal of the set, it shrinks a thing down to size in a way *accomplishable* never manages.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Concedes that the thing will take effort and says it fits inside capacity anyway, a fainter endorsement than *achievable*.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it looks past the doing to the outcome - the thing brought from prospect into fact.

entries.definition: capable of being affirmed or asserted
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and colourless: it rates whether a claim can be stood behind, and passes no judgement on the claim itself.
examples: a quality affirmable of every member of the family

entries.definition: capable of being affirmed or asserted
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunter in its verb than *affirmable* - putting a claim forward rather than standing behind one - but it carries no more approval.

entries.definition: capable of being attained or accomplished
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Points at something wanted and says the reach is long enough, giving it a pull toward the goal that *possible* has none of.

entries.definition: capable of being attained or accomplished
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and homely, it makes the thing sound simply within arm's length, deflating the reach that *attainable* dignifies.
examples: art is not something that is come-at-able by dint of study

entries.definition: possible but not certain to occur
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one member that withholds - it grants the possibility and in the same breath refuses to promise it, hedging where *feasible* endorses.
examples: they had to plan for contingent expenses

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A working verdict rather than a hope: it says the thing can be done with what is at hand now, a test *possible* never applies.

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most procedural of the set, it asks only whether the steps can be carried out and offers no opinion on whether they should be.

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and faintly grudging, it certifies that a thing can be put into practice without claiming it will go well, unlike *viable*.

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest endorsement here - it declares a plan sound enough to go ahead on as things stand, where *workable* says only that it will function.

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Modest and practical - it promises the thing will function, not that it will succeed.

entries.definition: serenely self-possessed and free from agitation especially in times of stress
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of steadiness held on purpose - the serenity is a bearing kept up while the pressure is on, not the luck of an easy hour.
examples: the performer seemed completely composed as she stepped onto the stage
I felt calm and more composed than I had in a long time

entries.definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word of the family - mildly approving, naming the absence of agitation without the lift *serene* gives the same state.

entries.definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly descriptive: it registers that agitation is absent without crediting anyone for holding it off.

entries.definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Raises the same unagitated state into something luminous and admired, where *calm* merely reports it.
examples: he remained serene in the midst of turbulence
a serene expression on her face

entries.definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The stillest word here - the self-possession sounds effortless rather than exerted, unlike the braced steadiness of *composed*.

entries.definition: not easily perturbed or excited or upset; marked by extreme calm and composure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Stately and strong: it describes calm that cannot be shaken, not merely calm that happens to be unshaken.
examples: hitherto imperturbable, he now showed signs of alarm

entries.definition: not easily perturbed or excited or upset; marked by extreme calm and composure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and warmly admiring where *imperturbable* is dignified, praising the same immunity to upset in cheerful terms.

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain approval for having one's faculties gathered and in hand - steady rather than impressive.
examples: the witness remained collected throughout the cross-examination

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it prizes evenness above all: control that holds the level rather than control that shows.

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds bearing to the control - the faculties are not just held but held gracefully, which *collected* never claims.
examples: perfectly poised and sure of himself

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits the control explicitly to the person exercising it, sounding more effortful than the smooth *poised*.

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises control that needs nothing from anyone else, with a reserve at its edge that *poised* does not carry.
examples: more self-contained and more dependable than many of the early frontiersmen

entries.definition: in full control of your faculties
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Weightier than *collected*: the faculties are owned rather than merely gathered, and the ownership is the compliment.
examples: strong and self-possessed in the face of trouble

entries.definition: marked by calm self-control (especially in trying circumstances); unemotional
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal approval with a chill in it - the self-control reads as unbothered, and the unemotional side can tip into indifference.

entries.definition: marked by calm self-control (especially in trying circumstances); unemotional
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the weight on judgement rather than temperature, praising the head that keeps working when circumstances turn trying.

entries.definition: marked by calm self-control (especially in trying circumstances); unemotional
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Frames the composure as the sheer absence of nerves, which reads as coldness as readily as courage.
examples: the most nerveless winner in the history of the tournament

entries.definition: wanting in physical strength
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it names the missing physical strength and stops there, where every sharper member adds an attitude to the same fact.

entries.definition: lacking vigor or energy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the missing vigor into something thin and drained, as though what is left had been diluted rather than merely reduced.
examples: an anemic attempt to hit the baseball

entries.definition: lacking vigor or energy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying the identical sting - vigor thinned out, not simply lessened.

entries.definition: lacking energy or vitality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical in register, presenting the absence of energy as a condition to be observed rather than a failing to be scored.

entries.definition: lacking energy or vitality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical rather than evaluative - the want of vitality reads as a settled characteristic, not the temporary drain that *enervated* implies.

entries.definition: lacking energy or vitality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Implies vitality that was once there and has been taken away, so it asks for sympathy where *lame* asks for scorn.

entries.definition: lacking energy or vitality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The vitality has gone slack rather than been broken, leaving a limp, unstrung quality that *debilitated* renders as damage.

entries.definition: lacking strength or vigor
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest way of falling short - strength barely registering rather than failing, nearer to almost-nothing than to inadequacy.

entries.definition: lacking strength or vigor
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Harsher than *faint* for the same shortfall - the lack sounds pitiable, and pity here shades into a verdict that it was never going to be enough.

entries.definition: pathetically lacking in force or effectiveness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Withering - the failure is not merely ineffective but embarrassing, contemptible for having been attempted at all.

entries.definition: lacking solidity or strength
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The weakness is structural and imminent: the thing will give way under any real pressure.

entries.definition: lacking solidity or strength
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cooler and more formal than *flimsy* - there is simply not enough there to be solid, with no promise of collapse attached.
examples: vinyl siding has become the standard-bearer for cheap, insubstantial construction

entries.definition: badly or hastily built
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Damns the making rather than the thing - it says somebody rushed it or botched it, and the word will not let that go.

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Of light, it reports thin brightness plainly, without the sickliness *pallid* or the melancholy *wan* brings to the same dimness.
examples: the pale light of a half moon
the late afternoon light coming through the el tracks fell in pale oblongs on the street

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the dim light sound drained and washed out, an unwell version of what *pale* states neutrally.

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The weak light sounds dispirited, a dimness with something melancholy in it that *pale* would only measure.

entries.definition: responsible for or chargeable with a reprehensible act
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain verdict, covering both the one who did the reprehensible act and the one merely chargeable with it - responsibility and accusation under a single word.

entries.definition: deserving blame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mildest of the blame words, locating blame without characterising the deed, where *guilty* already calls the act reprehensible.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Weighs the deed and finds it has earned censure, a considered verdict rather than *at fault*'s bare attribution.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flat and formal, stating only that blame may properly be laid, without *blameworthy*'s sense that the deed went out and earned it.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Equally impersonal, taking the wrong, the evil and the merely injurious alike without changing temperature.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the blame inside the thing as a quality it is full of, where *blameworthy* says only that blame is deserved.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pitches the fault toward reproof that could be pronounced out loud, the most public-facing of these.

entries.definition: deserving blame or censure as being wrong or evil or injurious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The coolest of these, recording fault as a determination, which is why it sits as easily on the injurious as on the evil.

entries.definition: guilty of murder or bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gravest here - guilt of killing rather than of a misdeed, and the word treats it as a stain carried rather than a charge answered.

entries.definition: liable to be accused, or cause for such liability
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and procedural, recording exposure to accusation and resting as readily on the cause as on the person, so it asserts no wrong.

entries.definition: liable to be accused, or cause for such liability
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Weights that same liability toward formal accusation, sounding graver than *chargeable* while claiming no more guilt.

entries.definition: affected by conscience
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one inward member, guilt felt from inside rather than laid on from outside, with the conscience itself doing the striking.

entries.definition: guilty of crime or serious offense
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hard and total, making the wrongdoing a category the person belongs to, and it reaches past crime proper to any serious offense.
examples: criminal in the sight of God and man

entries.definition: guilty of a misdeed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lighter than *criminal* by the size of the deed, chiding a misdeed rather than condemning a crime.

entries.definition: liable to a fine
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely procedural, measuring the offence as money owed and judging the offender not at all.

entries.definition: liable to a fine
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: As bloodless as *finable* - a penalty attaches, and nothing is said about the wrong or the wrongdoer.

entries.definition: extended meanings; especially of psychological coldness; without human warmth or emotion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat, unfigured term for the whole condition, naming the missing human warmth without deciding whether it is a settled nature or a rebuff aimed at someone.

entries.definition: unmoved by feeling
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Near-clinical: it reports feeling as simply absent from the person, with none of the unfriendliness *icy* points at a target.
examples: he kept his emotionless objectivity and faith in the cause he served

entries.definition: unmoved by feeling
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Where *emotionless* records no feeling at all, this faults a missing ardour, the flatness of something that ought to have had fire in it.
examples: this passionless girl was like an icicle in the sunshine

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Severe and unbending, the coldness hardened into a settled refusal of cordiality rather than the passing chill of *frosty*.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The lightest chill of the group, a manner cooled and capable of thawing, not the fixed disdain of *glacial*.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coldness as arrest: cordiality not merely withheld but stopped dead, the unfriendliness locked in place.
examples: a frozen look on their faces

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heaviest cold here, vast and immovable, a disdain that takes no trouble to hide itself.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cold with an edge on it, the chill pointed at someone and meant to cut, where *wintry* only surrounds them.

entries.definition: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bleak rather than sharp, an unwelcoming climate about the person instead of the single stroke of *icy*.

entries.definition: marked by great psychological weight; weighted down especially with sadness or troubles or weariness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest name for the condition itself, sadness or trouble felt as weight from inside, where *burdensome* describes the load from outside.

entries.definition: not easily borne; wearing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the difficulty in the thing rather than the bearer: a load fixed on you that has to be carried, not merely a strain that tires.
examples: the burdensome task of preparing the income tax return

entries.definition: not easily borne; wearing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal member, and the heaviest-sounding of the three, where *taxing* keeps the same complaint everyday.
examples: my duties weren't onerous: I only had to greet the guests

entries.definition: not easily borne; wearing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Leans on the wearing half of the sense, draining strength steadily rather than crushing, the lightest of the three.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain, full-strength member of the group, naming real hurt and not merely unease.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*, with the same weight of hurt behind it.
examples: lived in heroic if something distressful isolation

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Aimed at composure rather than comfort, it unsettles and goes on unsettling, where *distressing* simply hurts.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest and most formal here, ruffling the mind where *disturbing* unseats it.
examples: a revelation that was most perturbing

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Quiet and persistent, a worry that nags at you instead of striking, understated beside *distressing*.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Treats the power to cause anxiety as a standing property of the thing, where *worrying* reports what it is doing now.

entries.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

entries.definition: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most physical word in the family, heaviness and weariness fused into dead metal, dull and unliftable.

entries.definition: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest member, recording that the weight has been put on without making the weariness of it felt as *leaden* does.

entries.definition: weighing heavily on the senses or spirit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The strongest weight here, pressing on the senses as much as on the spirit and leaving no room to breathe.

entries.definition: weighing heavily on the spirit; causing anxiety or worry
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Grave rather than smothering, the weight registering as anxiety carried, where *oppressive* closes in.

entries.definition: showing or indicating careful judgment and discernment especially in matters of taste
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for judgment fine enough to show itself in taste, where *selective* reports only that choices are being made.
examples: the discriminating eye of the connoisseur

entries.definition: having or showing appreciation or a favorable critical judgment or opinion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm rather than cool - the judgment it names is a favourable one, or else plain appreciation, where *discriminating* says only that the judgment is fine.
examples: an appreciative laugh from the audience

entries.definition: capable of distinguishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly technical: a capacity to tell things apart, carrying none of the credit *discriminating* hands whoever has it.

entries.definition: capable of distinguishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The same bare power of distinguishing, stated as a property of the thing that separates rather than a compliment to it.

entries.definition: able to make or detect effects of great subtlety; sensitive
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise aimed at fineness of perception - it can both produce and catch effects too subtle for a coarser eye, where *selective* only picks among what is already plain.

entries.definition: capable of making fine distinctions
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A faculty word - the fineness sits in the distinctions themselves, not in any credit to whoever makes them.

entries.definition: capable of making fine distinctions
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the same capacity as *discriminative* and stays as neutral about it, describing a power to separate rather than approving its exercise.

entries.definition: selecting what seems best of various styles or ideas
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of breadth: the choosing ranges across styles and takes the best of each, where *selective* only narrows.

entries.definition: generally admired
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The broadest approval here - admiration granted with none of the account of the judgment behind it that *discriminating* insists on.

entries.definition: tending to select; characterized by careful choice
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mild credit for care in choosing, covering both the habit of picking and the carefulness of the pick, without claiming the taste *discriminating* asserts.
examples: an exceptionally quick and selective reader

entries.definition: not performing or able to perform its regular function
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical and blameless — it reports the failure as something happening in the working, where *bad* condemns the thing outright.

entries.definition: not performing or able to perform its regular function
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly negative where *malfunctioning* implies a thing still trying: the function is simply absent, stated as a condition rather than a misbehaviour.

entries.definition: not functioning properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest word here — it registers that something is off without saying how far or how badly.

entries.definition: not functioning properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: More visual than *amiss*, the working gone crooked rather than merely faltering, but pressing no harder.

entries.definition: not functioning properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and loud — not a quiet fault but a thing thrashing beyond control.

entries.definition: not functioning properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The barest of them, saying only that something is not as it should be, with none of *haywire*'s noise.
examples: something is wrong with the engine

entries.definition: not working properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and wholesale — it writes the thing off as no good instead of naming what has gone wrong inside it.

entries.definition: not working properly
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the fault inside the thing as a flaw it carries, cooler and more damning than *bad*.

entries.definition: out of balance or out of adjustment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and forgiving — the trouble is balance or adjustment, something slipped rather than broken.
examples: the front wheel of my bicycle is out of whack

entries.definition: having the spring unwound
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely mechanical: the spring has unwound, a state to be wound back and no reflection on the thing.

entries.definition: having odor or a characteristic odor
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's base term, covering both that a smell is present at all and that the thing has a smell of its own, and alone here it never says which smell.

entries.definition: smelling of onions or garlic
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal where the rest of the family is plain compounding, and it holds onion and garlic together rather than settling on either.

entries.definition: smelling of almond
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A flat identification of the source, describing the smell as almond's without any suggestion that this is welcome.

entries.definition: smelling of anise
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names a licorice-sharp source where *almond-scented* names a softer one, though the word itself is equally free of praise or complaint.

entries.definition: smelling of apples
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Takes its smell from a fruit rather than a spice or a resin, and like every compound here it identifies without evaluating.

entries.definition: smelling of balsam resin
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Fixes the smell to the resin rather than to the tree, making it the most exactly specified member of the family.

entries.definition: smelling of candy
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one compound whose source is a made thing rather than a plant, and it names that smell with no verdict attached.

entries.definition: smelling like cedar
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Alone in the family it offers a resemblance — smelling like cedar — rather than asserting the source's own smell as *cinnamon-scented* does.

entries.definition: smelling of cinnamon
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A warm spice named directly, the smell claimed as the spice's own rather than merely likened to it.

entries.definition: smelling of clove
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the sharper of the two baking spices here, yet the word passes judgement no more than *cinnamon-scented* does.

entries.definition: smelling of ginger
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Third of the kitchen spices in the family, labelling a smell by its source without hinting whether it pleases.

entries.definition: smelling of honey
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The sweetness sits in the source, not in the word, which reports it as flatly as *musk-scented* reports a heavier smell.

entries.definition: smelling of lemons
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Borrows a fruit as *apple-scented* does, the sour one against the sweet, with neither compound taking a side.

entries.definition: smelling of mint
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Cool where *cinnamon-scented* is warm, but that contrast belongs to the sources named and not to anything the words themselves approve.

entries.definition: smelling of musk
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one animal source among plants, spices and sweets, and the compound states it without the faintest verdict.

entries.definition: smelling of musk
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries the same sense as *musk-scented*, the -y form loosening the compound without changing what it identifies.

entries.definition: having or covered with or accompanied by blood
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain base of the family, equally at home with blood held, blood on the surface, or blood merely attending, and judging none of the three.
examples: the effects will be violent and probably bloody

entries.definition: containing blood
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely locational where *bloody* is open - the blood is inside the thing, a fact of contents with no verdict attached.
examples: the blood-filled centers of arteries and veins

entries.definition: covered with blood
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Treats the covering as a mark left behind, so the blood mars what it lies on rather than simply coating it.

entries.definition: covered with blood
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lurid where *bloodstained* is sober - the same covering turned into spectacle, with the recoil built in.

entries.definition: drawing blood from the body of another
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Frames the drawing of blood as feeding off another, so the offence is parasitism rather than violence.

entries.definition: marked by eagerness to resort to violence and bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the violence an appetite - it condemns the wanting, not the doing.

entries.definition: marked by eagerness to resort to violence and bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sites the same eagerness in the temperament, a settled cast of mind rather than the thirst *bloodthirsty* makes of it.

entries.definition: marked by eagerness to resort to violence and bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal, and the cool register lands strangely on an eagerness for bloodshed, condemning at arm's length where *bloodthirsty* condemns close up.
examples: went after the collaborators with a sanguinary fury that drenched the land with blood

entries.definition: characterized by violence or bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names violence by its colour, so the judgement arrives as an image and the word never has to state it.
examples: writes of crimson deeds and barbaric days

entries.definition: characterized by violence or bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The barest of the figures - the colour carries the violence with none of the heightening *crimson* brings to it.

entries.definition: characterized by violence or bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Says outright what *crimson* and *red* say by figure, and holds whether blood is shed or only violence done.

entries.definition: characteristic of or capable of or having a tendency toward killing another human being
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Clinical in register and wide in reach, covering the settled tendency, the bare capacity, and the character of the act alike.

entries.definition: characteristic of or capable of or having a tendency toward killing another human being
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Brings the weight of the crime to the same range *homicidal* covers coolly, condemning in the act of describing.

entries.definition: accompanied by bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and cool, marking only that bloodshed attends - a circumstance noted, not an appetite exposed.

entries.definition: accompanied by bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the attending bloodshed sound wholesale, its weight falling on scale where *sanguineous* stays even.

entries.definition: accompanied by bloodshed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts a butcher's hand on the bloodshed - crude and workmanlike, contemptuous of the doer where *slaughterous* is merely grand.

entries.definition: readily apparent to the mind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain term for the property, stating that a thing reaches the mind without effort and passing no judgement on whether that is a merit.
examples: a clear indication that she was angry
gave us a clear idea of human nature

entries.definition: lacking subtlety; obvious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faintly disapproving - the obviousness is heard as something laid on too thickly, an excess where *unsubtle* reports only a lack.
examples: gave us a broad hint that it was time to leave

entries.definition: lacking subtlety; obvious
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Criticism by subtraction - it names the delicacy that is missing rather than the heaviness that replaced it, so the fault reads as a deficiency.

entries.definition: clearly or sharply defined to the mind
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of edges - the outline is sharp enough that there is no blurred margin left to argue over.

entries.definition: clearly or sharply defined to the mind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The cool member of its group - sharpness of definition reported as a fact, without the approval in *clear-cut* or the bite of *trenchant*.
examples: Claudius was the first to invade Britain with distinct … intentions of conquest
trenchant distinctions between right and wrong

entries.definition: clearly or sharply defined to the mind
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with an edge on it - the definition cuts rather than merely bounds, a force *distinct* never claims.
examples: trenchant distinctions between right and wrong

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for language that offers no resistance at all, clarity felt as smoothness rather than as precision.

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plainer praise than *limpid* - the clarity is credited to the ordering of the thought rather than to the ease of the surface.

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal to the point of ornament - the compliment is paid in exactly the diction the clarity it commends would strip out.

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Polished praise - the language is treated as something seen straight through, admired for the absence of anything between reader and sense.

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The blunt, emphatic option - it insists nothing has been left to misread, with none of the polish of *pellucid*.

entries.definition: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and assessing - clarity approved as a property the language can be judged to have, not a pleasure it gives.

entries.definition: as it seems at first sight
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and provisional - it marks how a thing stands on first sight and reserves whatever a closer look might overturn.
examples: a prima facie case of murder

entries.definition: clearly evident to the mind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Force without approval - it makes clarity a matter of no other reading being available, which serves the unwelcome as readily as the welcome.
examples: his opposition to slavery was unmistakable

entries.definition: having the clarity and freshness of immediate experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm praise - the clarity comes with the freshness of something being undergone now, not merely well set out.

entries.definition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and unhedged, it names the effect on the person outright, reaching self-regard as well as mood where *cheerless* only reports what is missing.

entries.definition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Works by absence — nothing here to lift anyone — so it sinks the spirits without ever accusing the thing of anything.

entries.definition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest of these, a bare negation registering the missing cheer without the settled bleakness *cheerless* carries.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest here, casting a low mood rather than a heavy one, nowhere near the weight of *dismal*.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The dejection is cast over a thing rather than sitting inside it — a shadow, where *dreary* is a long dull stretch.
examples: the dark days of the war

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dispirits in a small, unfreshened way, too minor for the sweep of *dismal* but enough to flatten a mood.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: It marks a thing as past consoling, so the dejection comes with no way out of it, heavier in that than *gloomy*.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A flat, sweeping verdict of bleakness that sinks the spirits harder than *gloomy* and leaves nothing to salvage.
examples: the first dismal dispiriting days of November

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain middle of the family, naming the dejection without heightening it, where *dismal* passes judgement on it.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The hardest here, the gloom it causes carrying an edge of harshness, where *dreary* only wears you down.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dejection mixed with contempt: what it names is not merely dispiriting but pitiable, which *gloomy* never implies.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Dejection by monotony — it flattens rather than darkens, dispiriting without the menace of *grim*.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Barer and more literary than *dreary*, the same gloom in a word with nothing spare left in it.

entries.definition: causing dejection
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Gloom that goes on and wearies, so where *dismal* can be a single verdict this one drags.

entries.definition: grave or even gloomy in character
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Gravity first and gloom only at its far end, which lets it carry dignity in a way *dismal* cannot.

entries.definition: grave or even gloomy in character
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling and the same word entirely: grave in weight, gloomy only when pushed to its limit.

entries.definition: tending to entice into a desired action or state
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain name for the pull itself, and since the action drawn toward is one that is wanted, the word rates the force without rating where it leads, unlike *corrupting*.

entries.definition: highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Openly admiring - the attraction is a brightness that draws from a distance, with none of the spell-work *beguiling* implies.

entries.definition: highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The attraction works like a charm that holds you rather than a shine that catches you, so the hope it raises feels conjured where *alluring* simply glows.
examples: the voice was low and beguiling

entries.definition: highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The appeal arrives as an offer, pointing at a particular thing to be had, where *alluring* is a quality the thing merely possesses.
examples: difficult to say no to an enticing advertisement

entries.definition: highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The desire it raises is one you may have to weigh against yourself, so the pull is felt as pressure rather than as the clean invitation of *enticing*.

entries.definition: seducing into corrupt practices
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flatly condemning - it fixes on the ruin at the end of the pull rather than on the appeal that carries it there.

entries.definition: beguiling but harmful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The whole warning sits in the pairing: the charm is real and is exactly what keeps the harm out of sight, where *corrupting* announces the damage plainly.

entries.definition: arousing sexual desire without intending to satisfy it
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A light reproach - desire is raised deliberately and then left standing, so the fault named is the withholding rather than the attraction.

entries.definition: feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain inward word for the state, wide enough to hold guilt and remorse as well as shame, and unlike *disgraced* it reports the feeling without pronouncing on the person's standing.
examples: are you ashamed for having lied?
felt ashamed of my torn coat

entries.definition: suffering shame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The shame lands as a withdrawal of belief, where *disgraced* takes away the standing itself.

entries.definition: suffering shame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Total and public, the shame settled into a condition rather than the passing sting of *embarrassed*.

entries.definition: suffering shame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gravest and most formal of these, shame weighed against honour, where *shamed* is blunt and unceremonious.

entries.definition: suffering shame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bare and unadorned: shame worked on someone from outside, where *ashamed* is shame felt from within.

entries.definition: made to feel uncomfortable because of shame or wounded pride
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest and most survivable discomfort here, and the sting can be to pride as easily as to conscience.
examples: too embarrassed to say hello to his drunken father on the street

entries.definition: made to feel uncomfortable because of shame or wounded pride
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The discomfort is inflicted and meant to be felt, a deliberate lowering that *embarrassed* never implies.
examples: humiliated that his wife had to go out to work

entries.definition: made to feel uncomfortable because of shame or wounded pride
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hyperbolic in force: the discomfort is unbearable rather than merely awkward, and it can be pride that smarts.
examples: felt mortified by the comparison with her sister

entries.definition: showing a sense of guilt
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest of the words for guilt that shows, naming what is visible without the picture *hangdog* draws.

entries.definition: showing a sense of guilt
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Contemptuous and pictorial, the guilt showing as a cowering, beaten posture, and the word relishes saying so.
examples: the hangdog and shamefaced air of the retreating enemy

entries.definition: showing a sense of guilt
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the guilt exactly where it shows, on the face, without the whole cringing body of *hangdog*.
examples: the hangdog and shamefaced air of the retreating enemy

entries.definition: showing a sense of shame
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faintly comic and forgiving, the shame it shows small enough to be smiled at, where *hangdog* invites contempt.

entries.definition: causing or capable of causing harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: States damage done or damage merely possible and stops there, flatter and cooler than *abusive* or *bruising*, which put a victim in the sentence.
examples: too much sun is harmful to the skin

entries.definition: characterized by physical or psychological maltreatment
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heaviest word here, since the harm is maltreatment of a person in body or mind rather than the impersonal damage *harmful* allows.
examples: argued … that foster homes are abusive

entries.definition: capable of harming
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The blunt monosyllable for the capacity *harmful* names, warning that a thing can hurt without saying how or how much.

entries.definition: causing mental or emotional injury
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lends the body's word to injury of the mind, so the damage arrives as an impact that leaves a mark rather than *harmful*'s abstract capacity.
examples: protected from the bruising facts of battle

entries.definition: harmful to living things
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and clinical, it registers damage to living things as a finding rather than a complaint, cooling what *hurtful* says plainly.

entries.definition: harmful to living things
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain-spoken member of its trio, naming the same damage to living things in the everyday register that *deleterious* and *injurious* refuse.

entries.definition: harmful to living things
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal like *deleterious* but weightier, treating the damage as an injury sustained rather than an effect observed.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Elevated and heavy-tongued, it condemns the statement with a formality that makes the objection sound like a charge being laid.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The trimmer form of *calumniatory* and no gentler for it, the statement still handled as malice dressed up as report.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest of these, condemning the statement squarely for the damage it does to a name and doing without *calumnious*'s elevation.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the weight on the blackening of the subject rather than on the untruth, and is the stiffest of the three denigrat- forms.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most immediate of its trio, catching the statement in the act of running someone down.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and dispositional, marking the statement as the belittling kind rather than *denigrating*'s act in progress.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: British spelling of *libelous*, and it carries the same weight, an accusation levelled at the statement rather than a description of it.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Accusatory where *defamatory* is merely descriptive, charging the statement with the harm instead of noting that it does harm.

entries.definition: (used of statements) harmful and often untrue; tending to discredit or malign
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The hottest of the set, hearing deliberate malice in the discrediting rather than *defamatory*'s cooler damage to reputation.

entries.definition: difficult to understand
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: States the difficulty and nothing more, with no hint of whether the fault lies in the style, the subject or the reader.
examples: the most incomprehensible thing about the universe is that it is comprehensible

entries.definition: difficult to understand
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries exactly the force of *incomprehensible* with a makeshift ring, the un- prefix doing plainer work than the in-.

entries.definition: marked by difficulty of style or expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the hard style feel withheld rather than merely difficult, as though something were being kept unlit.
examples: much that was dark is now quite clear to me

entries.definition: marked by difficulty of style or expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same fault in the writing stated without *dark*'s metaphor: the style is at fault, and that is all it says.
examples: those who do not appreciate Kafka's work say his style is obscure

entries.definition: not clear to the understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one member that makes unclarity attractive, so that what is not clear reads as worth puzzling over rather than as a failing.
examples: I didn't grasp the meaning of that enigmatic comment until much later
prophetic texts so enigmatic that their meaning has been disputed for centuries

entries.definition: not clear to the understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal where *enigmatic* is quick, the longer ending adding stiffness without adding any mystery.

entries.definition: not clear to the understanding
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The mildest of the three, making the unclarity a snag to be worked at rather than *enigmatic*'s standing invitation.

entries.definition: incapable of being fully understood
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Depth is the image, and it grants that understanding goes some way down and simply never reaches the bottom.

entries.definition: impossible to understand
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Absolute and sealed: where *unfathomable* leaves partial understanding possible, this shuts it out altogether.

entries.definition: impossible to determine the meaning of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Treats the thing as a code that will not yield, so the defeat is at the level of meaning rather than of style as in *obscure*.

entries.definition: not caught with the senses or the mind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Lays blame nowhere, reporting only that the thing failed to arrive, slipping past the senses or past the mind.

entries.definition: not caught with the senses or the mind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Hangs the same failure of catching on the one who did not catch it, where *lost* leaves the thing merely gone astray.

entries.definition: hard or impossible to understand
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A surface that shows nothing through it, stretching from hard going to flatly impossible.

entries.definition: hard or impossible to understand
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt where *opaque* is figurative, and it reaches the same distance: from hard to make out to not to be made out at all.
